description: Compress CSS by stripping comments, collapsing whitespace and removing redundant semicolons, with before/after byte stats.

faqs.a: It removes /* */ comments, collapses whitespace, strips spaces around punctuation, and drops unnecessary semicolons before closing braces.
It is regex-based and safe for normal CSS. Very complex data URIs or exotic hacks could theoretically be affected — validate critical stylesheets after minifying.
faqs.q: Is it safe for all CSS?

faqs.a: No. Everything runs locally in your browser; your CSS is never uploaded.

howto: Paste your CSS into the input box.
Review the original vs minified byte stats and the percentage saved.
Copy the result or download it as a .css file.
title: CSS Minifier
